summary.text: Craig Haggard is a Republican member of the Indiana House representing District 57, which includes portions of Hendricks, Johnson and Morgan counties, elected in 2022.
The caucus page lists his service on the Veterans Affairs and Public Safety Committee.

paragraphs.text: Haggard is a graduate of Hanover College and Mooresville High School and works as a commercial broker and small-business owner.

The page says he served in the U.S. Marines as an AV8B Harrier aviator for 11 years, was honorably discharged in 2000, and then served 11 more years in the Indiana Air National Guard, retiring as a lieutenant colonel in 2013.
He formerly served as the Indiana field representative for the National Rifle Association for six years.
Haggard lives in his hometown of Mooresville with his wife, Brooke, and their four children.
